cli.failure_details.exec_two.note: {count} is 2; {received} is an already localized list of repr-quoted input. {command} is an entire shell-safe lop exec --name command, inserted verbatim on its own line. ONE emphasizes exactly one prompt. Preserve --name and --workstream verbatim.

cli.failure_details.exec_many.note: {count} is >=3; {received} is an already localized list of repr-quoted input. No repair command: never silently discard extra prompts. Preserve --name and --workstream verbatim.
